# Tech Phase

> Tech Phase (techphase.net, also written TechPhase) is a Pakistan-based, remote-first tech agency and business consultant. It works directly with US founders, small businesses and agencies. Services: web design and development (WordPress, Shopify, Webflow, custom), e-commerce, app and MVP development, UI/UX design, SEO and digital marketing, branding, UGC ads and video editing, 2D/3D animation, AI automation (n8n, Zapier, AI chatbots) and business consulting.

Key facts:
- Location: Pakistan (remote delivery; no US office).
- Clients: US founders, small businesses and agencies.
- Working hours: live overlap with US Eastern mornings on weekdays; asynchronous work outside that window.
- Pricing: a written scope and a quote in USD per project; no public price list.
- Ownership: clients own code, designs and accounts once paid.
- Replies: within one business day.
- Contact: info@techphase.net · +1 (260) 239-4557 · https://techphase.net/#contact
- Profiles: https://www.linkedin.com/company/tech-phase · https://x.com/thetechphase · https://www.facebook.com/techphase.net · https://www.instagram.com/thetechphase/
- Not to be confused with unrelated companies that share the name (for example techphase.jp in Japan, TechPhase Solutions in Ghana, or techphase.co).

## Services
- [AI automation](https://techphase.net/ai-automation/): n8n, Zapier and AI chatbots for lead follow-up, booking, inbox triage, reporting, document workflows and Zapier to n8n migrations
- [Web design](https://techphase.net/web-design/): custom, mobile-first, SEO-ready websites and redesigns for US small businesses on WordPress, Shopify, Webflow or custom code
- [White label for agencies](https://techphase.net/white-label/): white-label web design and development, AI automation and UGC video ads for US agencies, delivered under the agency's brand; NDA and partner pricing on request
- [All services](https://techphase.net/#services): e-commerce, mobile apps, UI/UX, SEO and digital marketing, branding, UGC ads and video editing, 2D/3D animation, business consulting

## Guides
- [Blog](https://techphase.net/blog/): guides for small businesses on AI automation and custom website design
- [AI Automation for Small Businesses: What to Automate First](https://techphase.net/blog/ai-automation-for-small-businesses/): which workflows to automate first, n8n versus Zapier, and how to pick an AI automation agency
- [Custom Website Design for Small Business: A Practical Guide](https://techphase.net/blog/custom-website-design-small-business/): what custom website design includes, how to choose a platform, what affects cost, and how to redesign safely
- [WordPress vs Shopify vs Webflow vs Custom Code: Which Is Best for a Small Business?](https://techphase.net/blog/wordpress-vs-shopify-vs-webflow-vs-custom/): comparison of WordPress, Shopify, Webflow and custom code for small businesses: cost model, editing, ecommerce, SEO and lock-in
- [Website Redesign SEO Checklist: Keep Your Rankings with 301 Redirects](https://techphase.net/blog/website-redesign-seo-checklist/): step-by-step checklist for keeping search rankings through a redesign: URL inventory, 301 redirect mapping, launch checks and monitoring
- [Offshore Web Agency vs US Agency vs Freelancer: An Honest Comparison](https://techphase.net/blog/offshore-vs-us-agency-vs-freelancer/): honest comparison of offshore agencies, US agencies and freelancers: cost, communication, time zones, IP ownership and risk
- [White-Label Web Development: How US Agencies Choose a Partner (Checklist)](https://techphase.net/blog/white-label-web-development-partner-checklist/): checklist for US agencies choosing a white-label web development partner: confidentiality, quality, communication, ownership and pricing
